book.name: Filipo
book.title: Filipo Filipo Ekalesia mazao Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Kerisoꞌa Niḡa Mae Ovoiroteꞌe teige Nize Mae Ovoroꞌi
Za Keriso teite tiburanadu inareꞌehe? Kerisoꞌa zae zamaradu namizeꞌehe? Za Vine Zaḡoḡa teite uniheꞌehe? Za vaze mazao manoḡa haḡaeꞌehe zu vetuḡaziꞌehe?
Za ꞌouge radoꞌidene, zama tiba moꞌi, zu zama tibano zamarotitoꞌi, zu zama tibano tiburu gauoꞌi. ꞌOuge haḡadu eḡe matuꞌu ufeta borofonoꞌi.
Gau niduꞌa zamaḡano zae manoḡa daꞌo ago vaḡoꞌi, zu nize ago mae itoꞌi, rehano zaeꞌa bare nize mae ovoeꞌenaꞌa, vaze ꞌahogaꞌahogaꞌe ufeta manoḡa ebu zae vitizoga rae zamaroꞌi.
Za zae ura daꞌo ago zamaroꞌi, rehano vaze ura zuni zamaroꞌi.
Zae haḡaiꞌe Keriso Iesuꞌa haḡaidoteꞌe haḡaiḡa teigoꞌi.

content.text: Kerisoꞌe Badiꞌa iraḡa teite idaḡa rehano,
Badiꞌa teite idaruꞌeteꞌe niḡa boro meiro rae mene zamariro,
zu zamarone ꞌuguḡa mene gigaru oboniro.
zu aneꞌa bare niḡa mae ovoiro,
Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa ani mae ḡihinadu hitana huneo ohoniro,
ebu ni ꞌahogaꞌahoga niduꞌa vitineꞌeteꞌe niḡa boro haro.
ꞌOugadu adureo, rahao zu raha ꞌuꞌuḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌa,
Iesu ni zamao obenaze hina ḡuḡuriꞌuma,
Iesu Kerisoꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boro rae furenadu,
Badiꞌa emeḡe Mama ni mae ḡihiniꞌuma.

content: Rahao Buzuva teige Agaranoꞌi
Eꞌanoꞌo eḡe zamarone nego nabudi, zaeꞌa eḡe ḡoere iḡaiḡa egoharoteꞌe teige, rihau rudauꞌenaꞌa,
ḡabone hiditeꞌe ibiḡano ꞌaune inare gauoꞌi. Mene eḡeꞌa zae teite radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano daꞌo, rehano izidi eḡe oꞌoꞌano zuni eḡe ḡoere ufeta egohauꞌenaꞌa, inare gauoꞌi.
Mazaḡa zaeꞌa Badiꞌa ura haḡaoga uratifine zu eꞌe haḡae hunifine Badiꞌaꞌa zae zamao gaueꞌohe.
Maḡunu ḡoeꞌa raꞌenaꞌa zu taꞌirotiteꞌenaꞌa, ḡau niduꞌa ago haḡaoꞌi.
ꞌOugine zaꞌe veꞌoḡa oꞌoꞌa zu deheḡa reꞌuma, ebu izidi ega, haḡai veꞌoḡa zu sauꞌa azaḡa boꞌaḡano, veꞌoḡani ꞌahoga oꞌoꞌa radu Badiꞌa ubugaubuga reꞌuma. ꞌOugine zaꞌe raha ꞌadao buzuva teige agaraꞌuma.
Ḡabone ḡoeꞌa obone giganoꞌi. ꞌOugine, e Kerisoꞌa bare ariteꞌe madaḡano, eḡeꞌa zae veize mene foure gaue duriroteꞌe moneo niguniꞌuma.
Zaeꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano za zae ḡabone Badiꞌa dibuꞌohauꞌetene, vaini vuḡa beꞌuneꞌeteꞌe dibuꞌoḡa teige e ruhe zae rana beꞌunine zuni, matuꞌiꞌuma ebu zae niduꞌa teite matuꞌiꞌuma.
Eꞌe teige, zae zuni matuꞌoꞌi zu eḡe teite matuꞌihi.
Timoteo zu Epaforodito
Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu urao eꞌa Timoteo zae vaḡe ḡarihe tuḡunoga urateꞌohe. Aꞌe ani mazaonoꞌo zae hari egadu eḡe zuni inaroga veize raꞌohe.
Aniꞌa zaꞌe manoḡa ga meneꞌe hube hune zamareꞌohe. Eḡe mazao ani heuḡa vazeḡani ꞌahoga oꞌoꞌa.
Vaze niduꞌaꞌe Iesu Keriso ura haḡaogaꞌe mene zamareꞌohe, rehano zeḡe ura haḡaoga daꞌo zamareꞌohe.
Rehano za edeḡa, Timoteoꞌe vaze manoḡa. Moga teite gaueꞌeteꞌe ubuga teige, aniꞌe hari manoḡa haramoga veize eḡe teite gauiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo eḡe mazao naginiꞌa fureratiteꞌe ederine, ḡarihe fase ani zae vaḡe tuḡunihi raꞌohe.
Ebu eḡe zuni zae vaḡe ḡarihe amiꞌuma. Eꞌe ibiḡaꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa bohaniꞌuma rae e hube hune zamareꞌohe.

Epaforoditoꞌe eḡe nego, zu eḡe teite tiburu gaueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, zu hari manoḡa veize eḡe teige tiburu utiteꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa. Aniꞌe zaeꞌa eḡe uꞌa tuḡunadu eḡe mazao ferefiroteꞌe ḡauḡa nunu danahiro. Rehano e hube hune Epaforodito zae vaḡe bare tuḡuniꞌuma rae zamareꞌohe.
Mazaḡa ani zae niduꞌa ḡiazihi radu zamare huneꞌohe, ebu zaeꞌa ani uginiroteꞌe igiro ꞌahine, zamaḡaniꞌa aduduꞌohe.
Hube hune ani ugi boroꞌa madu nariga rudaro. Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa vetuḡaneadu fainiro. Mene ani daꞌo, rehano eḡe zuni vetuḡaheadu eḡe aduga rana aduga ꞌahoga mene bare ragatiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo e ani ḡarihe zae vaḡe tuḡunihi rae ufeta inareꞌohe. ꞌOugine, za ani bare horonadu matuꞌiꞌuma zu eḡe zamaꞌa aduduꞌeteꞌeꞌa ufiraꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo zaꞌe matuꞌe rudauꞌenaꞌa, Zuhiꞌa Boro niḡano ani mae zounoꞌi, ebu ani heuḡa azaḡa gubazoꞌi.
Mazaḡa aniꞌe Keriso gau uꞌano nariga rudaro, ebu zaeꞌa e danahogaꞌe mene idararoteꞌe madaḡano ani danahoga veize ḡaboneḡa nariga ahetiro.
